texto.es: Nos cuentas qué plaga tienes y en qué parte de la casa la estás viendo.
texto.en: Tell us what pest you are dealing with and where in the home you are seeing it.

texto.es: Revisamos la zona afectada y te explicamos el tratamiento recomendado antes de aplicarlo.
texto.en: We check the affected area and walk you through the treatment we recommend before applying it.

texto.es: Aplicamos el tratamiento pensando en mascotas, niños y plantas comestibles en el jardín.
texto.en: We apply the treatment with pets, kids and edible garden plants in mind.

texto.es: Volvemos si la plaga reaparece; varios clientes llevan años con nosotros por eso mismo.
texto.en: We come back if the pest shows up again; several clients have stayed with us for years because of it.

nota.es: Cada visita se cotiza según el tamaño de la propiedad y la plaga. Llámanos y te damos el precio sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every visit is quoted based on property size and the pest involved. Call us and we will give you a price, no strings attached.

texto.es: Cucarachas, hormigas, arañas y otras plagas comunes del hogar, con tratamiento seguro para la familia.
texto.en: Roaches, ants, spiders and other common household pests, treated safely for your family.

texto.es: Retiro de panales y colmenas de techos, antenas y aleros, con equipo apícola propio.
texto.en: Nest and hive removal from roofs, antennas and eaves, with our own beekeeping gear.

texto.es: Tratamiento de jardín y exteriores, muchas veces en la misma visita en la que revisamos la plaga.
texto.en: Lawn and yard treatment, often on the same visit we come out for pest control.

texto.es: Visitas programadas para casas que prefieren prevenir antes que tener una plaga activa.
texto.en: Scheduled visits for homes that would rather prevent an infestation than deal with one.

pie.es: ¿No ves exactamente lo que necesitas? Llámanos igual, lo cotizamos.
pie.en: Do not see exactly what you need? Call us anyway and we will quote it.

items.quote: I've used Dennis many times over the years and I still use him often. He's always punctual, professional, honest, and reliable. His prices are fair and he always does a great job. Definitely someone you can trust and I highly recommend him.

They've been coming to our home for the last 5 years, always punctual, and they come more frequently if there's a bug issue. Dennis does an excellent job with follow-ups and takes care to avoid using standard pesticides, ensuring the safety of fruit-bearing or edible plants. Highly recommended.

Excellent service. I have been using Pest Free Home for some time. I called them because I had an infestation of roaches. The problem was quickly solved and we have been bug free ever since! They are punctual, professional and priced very reasonably.
